mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that negatively impacts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5%+ drop in IP.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected spike in the unemployment rate signals a labor market shock that negatively impacts consumer spending and S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 70% of months following a 0.3pp+ spike in UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that negatively impacts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of 3-month periods following a 0.5pp+ rise in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales signals a demand shock that negatively impacts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 1%+ drop in RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in housing starts signals increased construction activity that boosts economic growth and S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following rising HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in nonfarm payrolls signals a tight labor market that boosts wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 60% of months following a 300k+ rise in PAYEMS.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the consumer price index signals rising inflation expectations that erode real equity returns, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months following rising CPI.
